questions.direction_text: Read the following information carefully and answer the following questions. Twelve persons are sitting in two parallel rows containing six persons each in a way that there is an equal distance between two adjacent persons. A, B, C, D, E, F sits in row 1 and faces north, P, Q, R, S, T, U sits in row 2 and faces south but not necessarily in the same order. Therefore, in this arrangement each member seated in a row faces another member of the other row. A sits fourth to the left of B and one of them sits at corner. Only one person sits between Q and R. C sits third to the right of D. R faces C. More than two persons sit to the right of Q. Only one person sit between P and T and T does not sit near to Q. Two persons sit between U and S who does not face A.

options.d: The person sitting immediate right of U
